util

Class PeekingIterator<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • util.PeekingIterator<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the type of elements returned by this iterator
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.util.Iterator<T>

    public final class PeekingIterator<T>
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.util.Iterator<T>
    Provides an decorated Iterator that supports look-ahead operations via a peek() method without advancing the underlying iteration state.

    This utility is particularly effective for the left to right advancement parsing or command-line argument processing where the current token determines the handling of the subsequent element.

    Change History:

    • Created by Trevor Maggs on 12 October 2021
    • Revised for improved cursor logic and collection support on 29 March 2026

        private void advance()
        Caches the next element from the underlying iterator. Advances the iterator to cache the next element, allowing either the next() or peek() method to be called without throwing an exception.
